correctness.rationale: For the exact real map \(T_h(x)=x-hx/(1+x^2)\), \(h>0\), \(T_h^2(x)-x\) is a rational function with everywhere-positive denominator and numerator \(-hx[2(1+x^2)-h][(1+x^2)^2-hx^2]\). Its three factors give all fixed and prime-two points without finite search; the quartic branch has positive reciprocal roots precisely for \(h>4\). Multipliers are \((3-8/h)^2\) (symmetric) and \(9-2h\) (each asymmetric), with strict stability ranges \(2<h<4\) and \(4<h<5\). The included verify.py was executed and passed exact integer-polynomial expansion and exact rational sample checks. Boundaries h=2,4,5 and nonhyperbolic multiplier behavior are explicitly stated; no unproved claim about higher periods or nonlinear marginal stability is made.
